g.text: ALL CONTRIBUTED PROJECTS · STRICTLY ABOVE 100K STARS
QUALIFIED CONTRIBUTION SET / 严格 >100K 完整集合
跨心跳与对话策略缺口保留会话上下文，减少重置与缓存抖动。
Preserves reusable session context across heartbeat and chat policy gaps.
完善 TypeScript/JavaScript 命名规约与代码风格指引，提升智能体生成代码一致性。
Establishes explicit naming conventions and style rules for TypeScript/JavaScript.
让受保护文件写入在桌面端呈现明确审批，避免静默超时。
Surfaces protected file-write approvals in Desktop instead of timing out.
保留失败回合的推理签名链，确保工具调用可被模型安全重放。
Preserves signed reasoning context for valid tool-call replay.
显式化原生客户端构建契约，让异构部署具备可复现前提。
Makes native client prerequisites explicit for reproducible deployment.
修复 HuBERT 位置卷积在 BatchNorm 模式下的填充敏感性，消除音频嵌入偏移。
Fixes positional conv padding sensitivity in HuBERT when conv_pos_batch_norm=True.
把取消语义落实到传输生命周期，阻断后台任务与子进程泄漏。
Carries cancellation semantics through the transport lifecycle.
把 404 视为服务可达的路径响应，修复外部知识 API 误判。
Treats HTTP 404 as reachable endpoint evidence during API validation.
避免自定义模型别名导致同一基础模型被重复移除。
Prevents alias resolution from removing the same base model twice.
修复线程池执行器的生成器迭代器兼容性，守住异步与多线程执行边界。
Fixes generator iterable compatibility in ContextThreadPoolExecutor.map.
修复经典滚动条平台下 message-scroller 自动滚动时的频闪与重绘抖动。
Fixes scrollbar strobing during autoscroll on classic scrollbar platforms.
捕获 CRX 扩展包解压时的损坏 EOCD 定位异常，增强浏览器环境初始化鲁棒性。
Catches corrupt EOCD seek errors during CRX extraction for robust browser setup.
隔离 API Key 与残留授权头，避免认证机制在请求边界相互污染。
Isolates API-key auth from stale authorization headers at request boundaries.
修复 AOTInductor 在 CPU 架构指令集下级的判空兼容，保障编译导出可靠加载。
Fixes CPU ISA superset compatibility in _load_aoti for AOTInductor models.
